example.en: The cook threw away foul food.
The seller took out a rotten fruit.

critique.note: خَبِيثَة is not the natural word for a rotten fruit (that is فَاسِدَة) and the gloss "rotten" misleads; use e.g. شَمَمْنَا رَائِحَةً خَبِيثَةً "We smelled a foul odor."

example.en: The food became foul.

critique.note: Food spoiling is فَسَدَ, not صَارَ خَبِيثًا; use a natural foul-water/smell context, e.g. صَارَ مَاءُ الْبِئْرِ خَبِيثًا.

example.en: The boy said foul words.
The neighbors warned us about a malicious woman.
example.bs: Komšije su nas upozorile na zlu ženu.

critique.note: Grammar and translations fine, but content is a negative judgment of a person (neighbors warning about a wicked woman) - gossip-like, not gentle everyday content; prefer e.g. a malicious plan/rumor or a foul smell (رَائِحَة خَبِيثَة).

example.en: The water in the well became foul.
example.bs: Voda u bunaru postala je pokvarena.

critique.note: خَبِيث for spoiled well water is not idiomatic MSA (one says آسِن / مُلَوَّث / فَسَدَ الْمَاءُ); use a natural collocation such as رَائِحَة خَبِيثَة or مَرَض خَبِيث.

example.en: This disease is malignant.

critique.note: Correct MSA (masc. agreement هذا/المرض/خبيثٌ, nominative tanwin). مرض خبيث = standard everyday term for malignant disease; zloćudna correctly agrees with feminine bolest. Sober but not harsh; not Quranic wording.

example.en: The two brothers chose a similar color.

critique.note: مُتَشَابِه needs plurality (mutually similar); 'chose a similar colour' has no comparand. Use أَلْوَانًا مُتَشَابِهَةً or add لِلَوْنِ ...

example.en: The two students wrote the answer in a similar way.
example.bs: Dva studenta su napisala odgovor na sličan način.

example.en: The color of the two houses is similar.

critique.note: A single لَوْن cannot be مُتَشَابِه; use لَوْنَا الْبَيْتَيْنِ مُتَشَابِهَانِ ('the colours of the two houses are similar').

example.en: In the village there are similar houses.
The two brothers have a similar voice.

critique.note: similarity needs two items: singular صَوْتٌ مُتَشَابِهٌ is illogical (and en "have a similar voice" odd); use صَوْتَاهُمَا مُتَشَابِهَانِ / "similar voices"

example.en: This is an easy matter.
The child found an easy method.
The matter was easy.
These are easy matters.
The child carried a light load.
A light wind blew.
The load is light.
The children wear light garments.
In the house there is a secret door.
The child entered a secret room.
example.bs: Dijete je ušlo u tajnu sobu.

example.en: The door was secret.

critique.note: EN 'The door was secret' / BS 'Vrata su bila tajna' awkward; use 'hidden' / 'skrivena'.

example.en: The city has secret gates.
The road was hidden.
The judge gave a sound judgment.

critique.note: أَعْطَى حُكْمًا is a calque; MSA says أَصْدَرَ الْقَاضِي حُكْمًا سَدِيدًا.

example.en: The child learned the sound method.
The judge's judgment is sound.
The teacher taught us the sound methods.
example.bs: Učitelj nas je naučio pravilnim načinima.

example.en: The judge issued a correct judgment.
The mother purchased the fresh meat.
The child ate a fresh fruit.
This meat is fresh.
We ate some fresh fruits.

critique.note: Quranic dagger-alif spelling ثَمَرَٰتٍ in an MSA sentence; write ثَمَرَاتٍ.

example.en: In front of us is a long road.
It was a long night.
The road to the village was long.
example.bs: Put do sela je bio dug.

example.en: The man purchased long ropes.
My brother related an amazing dream.
example.bs: Moj brat je ispričao čudan san.

critique.note: EN 'amazing' vs BS 'čudan' (strange) diverge; align: 'a strange dream' / or BS 'čudesan'.

example.en: The teacher taught us in an amazing way.
example.bs: Učitelj nas je podučavao na čudan način.

critique.note: EN 'amazing way' (positive) vs BS 'na čudan način' (weird, negative); align both (e.g. 'wondrous' / 'na čudesan način'); gloss 'in a method' -> 'in a way'.

example.en: The dream was amazing.

critique.note: EN 'amazing' vs BS 'čudan' diverge; align to 'strange'/'čudan' or 'amazing'/'čudesan'.

example.en: The child related amazing dreams.

critique.note: EN 'amazing dreams' vs BS 'čudne snove' diverge; align.

example.en: My brother related an amazing dream.
example.bs: Moj brat je ispričao čudesan san.

example.en: The teacher taught us in an amazing way.
example.bs: Učitelj nas je podučavao na čudesan način.

example.en: The dream was amazing.
The child related amazing dreams.
The man remembered the difficult day.
It was a difficult year for the people.
example.bs: Bila je to mučna godina za ljude.

example.en: The year was difficult.
We lived through difficult days.
The father advised the disobedient child.
The neighbor has a disobedient daughter.
The child became disobedient.
The mother advised the disobedient daughters.
We saw the green crops in the village.
example.bs: Vidjeli smo zeleni usjev u selu.

example.en: We sat under a green tree.
The crops became green.
The house has green doors.
Our neighbor has a black dog.
My father purchased a black cow.
example.bs: Moj otac je kupio crnu kravu.

example.en: This dog is black.
The men wear black garments.
The people loved the pure boy.

critique.note: In MSA الْغُلَامُ الزَّكِيُّ reads 'the clever boy'; echoes غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا (19:19); BS 'čistog dječaka' sounds like 'clean boy'.

example.en: The child has a pure soul.

critique.note: نَفْسٌ زَكِيَّةٌ reproduces the Quranic phrase (18:74 نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً); choose another noun (e.g. قَلْبٌ زَكِيٌّ).

example.en: The child's soul is pure.
Pure souls love the good.
This is a pure act.

critique.note: زَكِيّ is idiomatic for persons/souls, "عَمَلٌ زَكِيٌّ" unidiomatic; "This is a pure act"/"čisto djelo" vague

example.en: The man lived a pure life.
We entered from the eastern gate.
We traveled to an eastern city.
The door of the house is eastern.

critique.note: EN 'The door of the house is eastern' / BS 'Vrata kuće su istočna' unnatural; e.g. 'The house's door is on the east side' or use 'eastern' attributively.

example.en: The merchant visited eastern countries.
This food is Eastern.
We walked on a broad road.
We slept in a wide room.

critique.note: غُرْفَةٌ عَرِيضَةٌ / 'široka soba' unnatural (MSA واسعة, BS prostrana); use a road/river/shoulders context, e.g. نَهْرٌ/سَاحَةٌ عَرِيضَةٌ.

example.en: The road to the city is broad.
In this country there are broad rivers.
example.bs: U ovoj zemlji ima širokih rijeka.

example.en: We boarded a broad ship.
example.bs: Ukrcali smo se na široku lađu.

example.en: The man swims in a deep sea.
In my father's speech there is deep wisdom.
example.bs: U govoru mog oca ima duboke mudrosti.

example.en: The sea is deep here.
Ships cross deep seas.
